_note: Which model does which job. Research is deep, multi-step reading with web search and fetch, so it runs on the current mid-tier model at high effort; raise effort before moving up a tier. Prices are dollars per million tokens (API reference, cached 2026-11-03) and cover tokens only: web search carries its own per-search fee that these figures do not include [verify].
